AI assistance

AI coding assistants, including Codex, were used extensively in implementation, investigation, analysis and preparation of this report. The package was assembled from saved project evidence and inspected source with Codex assistance.

Experimental claims are tied to named runs and recorded analysis. A separately implemented saved-data audit is distinguished from a second laboratory experiment. No external hardware replication or peer review is claimed.

The human contribution statement is maintained in CONTRIBUTIONS.md. AI tools are not listed as human authors. Full private conversations and prompts are excluded; no unaided invention or manual experimental activity is attributed without a documented basis.
